--- stdout
Health checks for your local dev services (probe vVERSION)

USAGE probe [OPTIONS] init|add|rm|ls|check|wait|open|curl|status|sync|migrate|completion

OPTIONS

  --interval=<seconds>    Seconds between two refreshes of the dashboard (probe alone, on a terminal) (Default: 2)

COMMANDS

        init    Create .probe/ and the .gitignore entries                           
         add    Add a service                                                       
          rm    Remove a service                                                    
          ls    List services                                                       
       check    Check that services respond (all of them by default)                
        wait    Check again and again until services are up (all of them by default)
        open    Open the URL of a service in the browser                            
        curl    Print the curl command that requests a service                      
      status    Show pending migration, Makefile state and updates                  
        sync    Add or regenerate the probe block of the Makefile (optional)        
     migrate    Migrate the config to the current schema version                    
  completion    Print the shell completion script (zsh, bash, fish)                 

Use probe <command> --help for more information about a command.

EXAMPLES

  probe init                            Start in this project
  probe add api -p 3000 --path /health  Declare a service
  probe check                           Check every service
  probe wait && pnpm test               Run the tests once all are up
  probe                                 Open the dashboard (on a terminal)

--- stderr
probe: No command specified. See: probe --help
